form.official-title: To extend the authority for modifications to the Second Division Memorial in the District of Columbia.

section.header: Extension of authority for modifications to Second Division Memorial
section.text: Notwithstanding section 8903(e) of title 40, United States Code, the authority provided by section 352 of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2018 (Public Law 115–91; 131 Stat. 1367) shall continue to apply through September 30, 20322033.
